copy.headline: Fort Worth police searching for Bria Greer, wanted on a sex offender failure-to-comply charge
copy.caption:
Fort Worth police are looking for Bria Greer, wanted on a sex offender failure-to-comply charge. Crime Stoppers is offering up to $2,000 for information leading to an arrest.

Call 817-469-TIPS (8477) or submit a tip at 469tips.com. You stay anonymous.
